Our 3 under-performing carriers need different fixes, not one conversation: Albion Parcel was fine all year then broke everywhere at once in Q4 (on-time dropped from ~90% to ~50%, still not recovered); Landfall Freight is just bad everywhere, all year (30-45% on-time); Lowlands Express is only okay on its home routes (Netherlands/Belgium/France) and weak everywhere else.

If we fixed those 3 weak carriers to match our good ones, we estimate it would eliminate roughly 40-55% of our overall delivery unreliability - a big lever, though we're still tightening up the exact number.

Good news on restocking: last week's apparent supplier backlog (~400 'stuck' purchase orders) was just a year-end timing illusion, not a real problem - once you give orders time to arrive, the backlog disappears. The real (unchanged) issue is that about half of all purchase orders arrive later than promised, every quarter, all year.
